expectations.buyer: Machine builders, factory safety engineers, integrators, and conformity-assessment teams
expectations.pain: PLC, drive, robot, and safety-logic changes can alter machine safety after initial conformity without a coherent cross-vendor state baseline
expectations.strongestIncumbent: PLM/QMS, OEM engineering tools, safety PLC signatures, version control, functional-safety assessments, and machinery conformity processes
expectations.biggestRisk: OEM tools already fingerprint configurations and legal revalidation depends on qualified human assessment rather than a universal drift rule
